09b2b8d9bc: So he didn't destroy it after all.
d66d1489c0:
Its destructive power rivals GENESIS.
Depending on where the relay points are placed,
it can hit anywhere on Earth at will.
81bf95546d:
If the choice is to obey or die,
the world will end either way as things stand.
We must fight.
d175ab75b1:
To dream and to hope for the future are the strength
every life is given in order to live. Every life fights
to win its future. It has every right to fight.
92590f43d3:
Ah, Rey. And Shinn too.
Thank you for coming.
e9973cf4bb:
Right now, Requiem's Station One
is under attack by the Archangel.
4c21aaef3f:
Truly troublesome.
We have no wish to fight any longer.
At this rate, it really will never end.
cc65f40f1d:
Yes.
But this time, we will end it.
33b6782377:
This time we must truly end it and change the world...
The Destiny Plan absolutely
must be realized.
e035dea3a0:
And what about you?
Do you feel the same, Shinn?
f15f30fd77:
......
I...
Yes, I feel the same as Rey.
e2b8671ac9:
To make an example of those opposed to the Destiny Plan,
Gilbert Durandal burned the Alliance's lunar base
with the giant beam weapon Requiem.
29f7af93df:
Though something in Durandal's and Rey's words
felt off to him, Shinn resolved to fight,
to break the chain of hatred...
a661570cb3:
This is mankind's last line of defense for its survival.
Anyone who opposes it
is an enemy of mankind.
f7deea2fed:
...Maybe.
He always had a soft side.
bfc61b9d98:
Was this really for the best...?
Maybe the fighting is over, but...
a2ead8224d:
In every age, change always breeds opposition.
There will always be those who suffer from it, and
those who object from mere anxiety, without clear reason.
e76a0cc8f2:
The Chairman is right.
Whatever happens from now on, whatever anyone says,
believe in the Chairman!
6fc25fd08c:
I-I know, Rey.
There's no going back now...
0023fa3fe3:
Requiem had been destroyed by Athrun, but after the
battle it was hastily repaired, and Durandal
once again set his sights on Orb.
5b2baa669a:
Terrified, Orb surrendered unconditionally,
and no one was left to stand against the Destiny Plan.
3644275299:
Lunamaria, whose machine was shot down by Athrun,
had miraculously returned unharmed.
